description: Mokwa Town, Nigeria Roads (OpenStreetMap Export) is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). OpenStreetMap contains roughly 205 km of roads in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 44 % of the total road length in the dataset region. Coverage: Mokwa Town. The portal files it under the publisher Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Its tags are geodata, roads, transportation. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-01-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
